worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.summary: A self-detonating gambit: lunge at the target, dealing fixed damage equal to your current HP on a hit before you fall. Strongest at full health and weakest when nearly down; a miss or type immunity spends nothing and leaves you standing. The spare form cuts the damage to 55%% and leaves you at 1 HP instead of fainting, at the cost of a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.descriptio: A hit deals %1$s fixed damage: your current HP at the moment of the cast at full commitment, or 55%% of it in the spare form. The target's defence does not matter; only type immunity stops it.
Prepare %1$s s (interruptible, and an interrupt does nothing at all), then lunge %2$s blocks along the aim (%3$s blocks/tick) with a %4$s block hit radius.
Knocks the target %1$s blocks along the lunge direction.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.spare.on: Spare form: damage drops to 55%% of your current HP; after a landed hit you are cut to 1 HP instead of fainting, with a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.spare.off: Full form: damage equals your full current HP; after a landed hit you faint.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.timing: Range %1$s blocks; prepare %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, cost %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.use.0: Trade yourself at full health to empty a high-value target
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.use.1: Drag a blocking threat down with you
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.use.2: Gamble for heavy damage but survive with the spare form
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.preference: On: damage drops to 55%% of your current HP and a landed hit leaves you at 1 HP without fainting, at the cost of a longer cooldown. Off: damage equals your full current HP and a landed hit faints you.
On: only commit when your current HP is not below the target's, guaranteeing the trade empties it. Off: also willing to drag the target down when badly hurt.
With 'only go for the kill' off, commit only when your HP falls below this share; higher makes it gamble sooner.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of detonating; it is a point-blank gamble.
When on, the user may leave its post to detonate; when off, it only detonates what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.growth.0: From level %1$s the stagger rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.growth.1: From level %1$s the stagger rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.finalgambit.outcome: The lunge detonates on the first foe it reaches; if it touches no one, is stopped by terrain, or is turned away by type immunity, it comes up empty - no HP is spent and you do not fall.
